messages:
jean: quick question — saw deploy-bot pick 3.1.2 even though UI shows 3.1.3 at top. why? :confused:

ravi: explanation: router uses semver core (major.minor.patch) and then artifact timestamp in buildmeta as tie-breaker. UI sorts by release time (display_ts) which can differ.

jean: ugh. humans assume top-of-list = router pick. can we make pinning less error-prone?

deploy-bot: proposal: when you pin, require full tag string (e.g. `3.1.3+docs.20250310.shaaa`). warn on index-based pinning. add `--show-routing-key` to CLI.

mae: also add normalized labels in UI: `3.1.3 (docs · 2025-03-10 · sha:aaaa)` and a badge that says "router=semver+artifact_ts".

ops-bot: ops asks: forbid docs-only tags from auto-promote during change windows unless `artifact_present=true` or release lead overrides. add CI lint to block weird metadata (`+meta+extra`).

ravi: consensus: routing = semver core then artifact ts; UI = sort by display_ts; deploy-bot/console to surface routing key and require copyable tag for pin/rollback. i'll draft the tiny RFC and a CI check.

jean: thanks — please also add a small runbook step: always confirm tag string before rollback. saved us last incident. :grimacing:
